build_task_template: build a phyre task template using define_task_template decorator with seed range and search params
build_task_scene: build a physics scene with slope, container, ball, table, and strut using build_task function
add_convex_polygon: add a convex polygon body to the phyre scene using C.add_convex_polygon with vertices
add_container: add a container object to the phyre scene using vt.add_container with goal vertices
update_task_goal: update the task goal to require ball touching container using C.update_task with SpatialRelationship
